common.searchModalText:
Different options are available from free text search covering all data columns, or column specific filtering. Note that:

  • Hidden columns are included
  • Searching is case-insensitive
  • Ordering of words does not matter (unless it is a Phrase)
  • TSV (text search vector) search only available for subscriptions table

For example:

  • "l2vpn" – free text search
  • tag:l2vpn – search in a specific column
  • tag:lp description:test – search in multiple columns
  • tag:(lp|lr) – multiselect within 1 column
  • -tag:lp – negated filter
  • test* – prefix filter

    • Note: Search words containing characters `|-*():"` may not be valid, as they are part of the search query grammar

    Invalid search strings are for example:

    • 2a10:e300:fff0::/48
    • "node123(planned)"
    • "node123|planned"
